mapper.select: SELECT CEILING(COALESCE(SUM(duration), 0)) FROM afv_storyboard_item WHERE storyboard_id = #{storyboardId} AND deleted = FALSE

SELECT i.id FROM afv_storyboard_item i LEFT JOIN afv_storyboard_scene s ON s.id = i.storyboard_scene_id AND s.deleted = FALSE WHERE i.deleted = FALSE AND (s.episode_id = #{episodeId} OR (i.storyboard_scene_id IS NULL AND i.storyboard_episode_id = #{episodeId})) ORDER BY COALESCE(s.sort_order, 0), s.id, i.sort_order, i.id LIMIT 501
